messages.subject: Announcement: Distance 4.0 Beta 1
parts:
________________________________________________

RESEARCH UNIT FOR WILDLIFE POPULATION ASSESSMENT
ANNOUNCEMENT
NEW SOFTWARE - DISTANCE 4.0
________________________________________________


Distance 4.0 Beta 1 is now available for download via the world-wide web.

The web site address for download is:

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

Distance 4.0 is a major update over the previous version (3.5). New features
include automated survey design and a new analysis engine that allows
multiple-covariates in the detection function. More information about the new
features is on the web site. There are also details of the new email
discussion group, distace-sampling-D4Beta. We encourage all users of
Distance 4.0 to join this group.

The current release is a public beta, released to give you a chance to try
out the new functionality. It is intended for use by more advanced users --
if you are new to distance sampling we recommend you use Distance 3.5 for
now.

One exception to the above is people who use Spanish language versions of
Windows. A bug in Microsoft Visual Basic prevented them from accessing
Distance 3.5 -- this has now been circumvented in Distance 4.0.

We hope you enjoy using the new software, and apologise for it being released
rather later than expected. We expect to release the full version before the
ICODS conference this summer.

- Len Thomas
Distance development project co-ordinator



--
